title: An agent on the team
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: an AI agent follows what's written down, works with least access, shows the query behind every claim and never weakens a test to pass it; reconciliation, a diff and CI check its work, and people approve.
howto: Code on dark glass is the project, and the small label beside it says where it runs. Teal is the AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval, never drawn on the agent's work until a person gives it. Red means a test stopped something; green, it passed; amber, a warning.
